# Stealthix Animated Traps (CC0)

Original sheets from `Traps.zip` (OpenGameArt). See `LICENSE.txt`.

## v0 trap mapping (Roguey2)

| Game trap | Source sheet | Sliced sprites (`../Sprites/`) |
|-----------|--------------|--------------------------------|
| **Spike Trap** | `Pit_Trap_Spikes.png` (32×32 static) | `SpikeTrap_Revealed.png` |
| **Bear Trap** | `Bear_Trap.png` (4×32×32) | `BearTrap_Revealed_Idle.png`, `BearTrap_Revealed_Triggered.png` |
| **Dart Trap** | `Push_Trap_Front.png` (wall emitter) | `DartTrap_Revealed_Idle.png`, `DartTrap_Revealed_Fire.png` |

Unused in v0: `Fire_Trap.png`, `Push_Trap_Right.png`, `Spike Trap.png` (alternate animated floor spikes).

In Unity: set **Pixels Per Unit** = 32, **Filter Mode** = Point, **Compression** = None for crisp pixels.
